paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy for various methods on BioGPT. The x-axis represents the co-occurrence number on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 1 to 10^4, with tick labels at irregular intervals. The y-axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 30% to 55%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. Six lines are plotted: Base (black, solid, circular markers), FT (blue, solid, triangular markers), IKE (red, solid, triangular markers), MEND (brown, solid, square markers), MEMIT (purple, solid, triangular markers), and ROME (green, solid, triangular markers). The Base line starts at around 30% accuracy at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increases to around 32% at 10^4. The FT line starts at around 32% and increases to around 39%. The IKE line starts at around 34% and increases to around 42%. The MEND line starts at around 36% and increases to around 45%. The MEMIT line starts at around 37% and increases to around 47%. The ROME line starts at around 44% and increases to around 58%.
